scope: synthetic checks of design defaults; V anchors are inputs or comparisons, never fitted twice
checks: every parameter carries a V/D/U tag and a note; only the five NFHS-5 and Holt-Lunstad anchors are V; bad overrides are refused
the implicit graph is seeded, symmetric and heavy-tailed (mean degree 111, median 70.0, max 467); a neighborhood query costs the same for 40,000 or 4,000,000 people

tie strength decays by the memory forgetting curve; contacts replay identically however a pair is queried; closer pairs have shorter gaps since last contact (Spearman -0.62) and kin shorter than friends (V direction); threat sensitivity suppresses contact over a negative memory and dysregulation turns it hostile

demography (calibrated only on median marriage age and adolescent fertility) gives period total fertility 2.11 (NFHS-5: 1.7; runs high on unverified parity factors), 25% of women 20-24 married before 18 (21.9%), median first marriage 19.7 (19.6) and life expectancy 73.7 without isolation

marriages are joint facts in both logs with no bigamy; a life resolved in one call or in chunks is identical; seeing someone alive moves a latent death later; seeing someone single rolls back the marriage and the partner's slice; committed facts are never rolled back; the commit horizon is the earliest uncommitted joint fact; resolving 600 women in reverse order keeps the married share (0.95 vs 0.95) and mean parity (1.33 vs 1.33)

composition-rejection picks channels in proportion to rate; on this graph wide confidence gives one opinion group and narrow gives 2 (sd 0.026 vs 0.423), and the mean-field compartment agrees (1 vs 6 peaks); a rumor reaches 358 people where a three-exposure behavior reaches 5; low reality testing discounts low-credibility sources less

institutions have no member list: a workplace's 47 members come from its region by hash, roles go to the best fit, sanction sensitivity is one formula over dials and traits (no archetype branch), and a collective event fires only once tension pushes the threshold cascade past the trigger (0.00 -> 1.00)
over 30 years capital is heavy-tailed (top 1% hold 25%), trait fit helps (Spearman 0.41) but the top outcomes are not all the best fits, and identical personalities in different networks end apart

the most isolated sampled person (isolation 0.60) carries a death hazard 1.26x the least isolated (0.00) as imposed, stronger under 65; deaths log tie losses and grief shifts on close survivors, and isolation slowly raises threat sensitivity

a model-proposed opinion change is clamped to the bounded-confidence rule (same direction, no larger), a post-check flags overshoot, personas are fixed per person, enmity sets a non-cooperation floor, and the variance monitor flags collapse

engine characters are bound into the population (a caregiver and child share a household), their circle reaches them as received observations (93 in a year for Priya), shown people are committed, the context section is stable between calls, checks are event-driven, a close death lowers the mood baseline even without preset dials, and a spoken turn moves opinions by the rule, never the model
